title: still present since round 3: demo_flow_test header claims bug-hunt E2E coverage that does not exist; demo_requests_are_intercepted_test cannot distinguish demo from real dispatch
evidence:
Line 13: '//// resolves it. The browser E2E (bug-hunt) covers the effect execution.' — but `ls .pi/skills/bug-hunt/scenarios/` shows only analytics/applications/auth/billing/comparison/dashboard/errors/landing/notifications/settings/ui/vacancies/workflows (no demo). The interception test asserts only `Loading` transitions; the REAL arm does the identical transition (client.gleam:1474-1479: 'AppRequestedDashboardData -> {
      #(
        Model(..model, vacancies: Loading, dashboard_stats: Loading),
        vacancy_api.list_vacancies(ApiReturnedDashboardData),'), so the test passes unchanged if the demo intercept is bypassed. The header also claims the lint 'bans rsvp / fetch / api_helpers imports in demo/' — rsvp import is explicitly allowed (parse_relative_uri) per the test.yml lint comment.
detail: Header promises E2E coverage that was never written, and the interception pin is vacuous — both arms produce the asserted Loading state. Header additionally misstates the lint's rsvp rule.
recommended_fix: Rewrite the header to drop the bug-hunt claim (or add a demo scenario), correct the rsvp wording, and assert a demo-store-produced value rather than the shared Loading transition.

title: still present since round 3: report_download_test pins the id mapping but not baked-asset presence — a deleted or misnamed PDF 404s silently
detail: The download button's target files (server/priv/static/demo/report-*.pdf) are never asserted to exist; renaming or losing one keeps all 611 client tests green while every demo download 404s.
recommended_fix: Add a build-time/server-side check that every report_filenames entry has a baked asset on disk (client tests cannot see the filesystem).

title: still present since round 3: pdf_prebake regen docs promise a positional CLI arg that main() never reads
evidence: Header: '////   gleam run -m demo/pdf_prebake -- server/priv\n////   (cwd = server/; the arg is the priv dir. Defaults to "priv" relative' — but main() (line 498) reads only the env var: 'let priv_dir = case envoy.get("RT_DEMO_PRIV_DIR") {'; no argv access exists in the file.
detail: Following the documented regen command passes an argument nothing reads; the real switch (RT_DEMO_PRIV_DIR) is documented only in a comment inside main().
recommended_fix: Fix the module header to document 'RT_DEMO_PRIV_DIR=priv gleam run -m demo/pdf_prebake' and drop the positional-arg sentence.

title: still present since round 3: Declan fixture household income (EUR 6,500/mo) is 1.86x his stated primary income (EUR 3,500/mo) with co_applicant_count 0 and one occupant
evidence: app_declan_json contains: '"monthly_income_cents":350000' ... '"num_occupants":1' ... '"guarantor_monthly_income_cents":310000' ... '"household_monthly_income_cents":650000,"co_applicant_count":0}' — household 650000 vs primary 350000 with no co-applicant; the guarantor's 310000 does not account for the 300000 gap (and guarantors are not household income).
detail: The detail page shows a household income nobody in the story earns; the demo's own module comment says household = primary + income sources + co-applicants, which this fixture violates.
recommended_fix: Set household_monthly_income_cents to 350000 (single occupant) or add the second income source to Declan's story.
